purpose: Define a machine-checkable semantic floor for operational Prompt Kit prompts so compiler overlays, compute profiles, provider limits, and later bulk edits cannot silently weaken agentic programming behavior.
authority_rules: Strengthen the smallest canonical shared owner instead of copying equivalent prose into many prompts.
Upstream repositories are donor/reference evidence, not Prompt Kit authority.
Prompts may direct application work but must not become the only implementation of deterministic application behavior.
Bounded mutation scope never implies bounded reasoning depth.
Profile overlays may specialize execution strategy but may not erase immutable semantic dimensions.

Every legitimate stop states the exact completed fixed point, blocker, unsafe boundary, external gate, or exhausted authorized scope; silent cessation at a tool or capability boundary is invalid while safe progress-bearing work remains.

Prompt mutation strength is semantic, not proportional to text length: protected ADD/EDIT/RETIRE flows must preserve or increase accepted capability/ownership at the Prompt Kit portfolio level, while compression removes redundancy without dropping unique obligations, boundaries, failure handling, proof, continuation semantics, or lifecycle history.

dimensions.summary: Every executable representation preserves the canonical prompt's required obligations unless an explicit semantic migration authorizes replacement.
Refresh repository/provider truth and reconcile branch-sensitive evidence before mutation or emitted commands.
Bounded scope constrains writes without shrinking reasoning depth; shared owners and forbidden surfaces remain explicit.
A first pass or first green is a checkpoint; continue while authorized progress-bearing work can materially reduce a required gap.
Exhaustive mode spends decision-relevant safe compute across acceptance, hypothesis, adversarial, validation, and residual-proof surfaces.
When graph width is at least two and safe capacity exists, independent lanes are actually launched concurrently and rejoined.
Failure of one worker adapter class does not imply global absence; continue through the evidenced adapter ladder before degradation.
Concurrent writers own isolated branches/worktrees/workspaces and non-Git shared resources are serialized or separately allocated.
Hosted CI/provider limits do not terminalize locally executable proof; local proof remains typed and does not impersonate hosted proof.
PLANNED, IMPLEMENTED, VALIDATED, INTEGRATED, DEPLOYED, and OBSERVED remain distinct and cannot be silently promoted.
Failed validation is diagnosed, repaired within scope, and rerun; failed or skipped checks cannot be converted into completion.
A green owned branch/PR is intermediate evidence; integrate into the refreshed default branch when all merge gates are satisfied.
Material execution plans live in tracked repository/provider state before handoff; chat alone is provisional.
Proof freshness depends on proof-relevant identity/revision inputs rather than repository HEAD equality alone.
Repeated identical external blockers with unchanged proof-relevance inputs enter a durable blocked state instead of creating churn.
Before fixed-point closeout, explicitly sweep for still-unspent authorized actions that could materially improve correctness or proof.
Upstream skills are pinned reference evidence; mechanics are extracted with provenance and routed to existing canonical owners before new prompt identities.
Next action is dependency-aware, executable, owner-assigned, and advances the next unproven state rather than narrating status.
Repository CLIs may validate runtime-tool dispatch records but may not impersonate unavailable tools or fabricate observed parallelism.
Review state is bound to the current head and authoritative review surfaces; capped loops return exact residuals rather than silent success.
Safely reproducible bugs capture a before-state and bind runtime evidence to exact revision/environment before the repair.

exhaustive.strategy: Use all decision-relevant safe available compute until an evidence-defined fixed point or exact blocker.

may_reduce: exhaustive-only residual sweep depth when acceptance is already covered

representation_invariants.authoritative_source: canonical prompt registry/body sources plus shared compiled policies
authorized_replacement_requires: proof that immutable semantic dimensions survive or are intentionally superseded by a stronger equivalent
representation_invariants.compression_is_not_weakening: Character count is a representation budget, not a strength score. A shorter prompt is accepted only when canonical/effective semantics and protected regression obligations are preserved or strengthened through the mutation lifecycle.

required_sequence: strengthen existing owner before adding a prompt identity

required_checks: all contract dimensions are unique, typed, and carry semantic evidence terms
efficient mode preserves every dimension marked required_in efficient
every dimension is exercised by at least one adversarial case
every case credits only dimensions whose evidence terms appear in its stimulus/assertions
every adversarial case defines typed positive and negative assertions
PSA-031 preserves the explicit silent-stop boundary regression
dependency snapshots pin exact heads and content anchors instead of PR numbers alone
no case claims downstream model obedience from repository/static proof

proof_ceiling: Repository contract, matrix, and validator semantics only. This design can prove coverage of declared prompt-strength dimensions and adversarial expectations; it does not prove downstream model obedience, live sub-agent availability, hosted CI availability, browser/device behavior, deployment, or operator acceptance.
